question: The Central Government of India has reduced Agricultural Infrastructure Development Cess (AIDC) on Crude Palm Oil (CPO) from 7.5% to _________ with effect from 12th February 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Central Government of India has reduced Agricultural Infrastructure Development Cess (AIDC) on Crude Palm Oil (CPO) from 7.5% to **5%** with effect from 12th February 2022.
 
• This reduction aims to lower the cost of crude palm oil and benefit consumers by reducing the prices of edible oils.
 
• The AIDC is a tax levied on the import of certain goods to finance agricultural infrastructure and other development activities in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The reduction in AIDC on CPO is expected to help in controlling the inflationary trends in the edible oil market.
 
• India is one of the largest importers of edible oils, and crude palm oil constitutes a significant portion of these imports.
 
• The government periodically reviews the cess and duties on imports to ensure the interests of both consumers and domestic producers are balanced.
 
• The AIDC was introduced in the Union Budget 2021-22 as a measure to boost agricultural infrastructure in the country.
